encoding.feature_rows: Array position (0-based) corresponds to local line N=position+1. [character_mention_mask, lexical_feature_mask]. A set bit means its word appeared in raw line. This does not establish an event, intent or truth of claim.

verification_note: Every source line has one feature row. This is mechanically computed and MUST NOT be called 69-episode human review, age determination or scene verification. A mention of kiss may be a memory, hypothetical or dialogue, not completed contact.
